name: Hotel Gesser
beschreibung: The Hotel Gesser is located in the center of Sillian, a village in Osttirol on the border with Südtirol. The house offers modest rooms and traditional dining with regional cuisine. From here, guests can reach the Skigebiet Hochpustertal as well as hiking trails in the immediate vicinity. For dinner there are local dishes, and the breakfast buffet is well stocked. The hotel is suitable for travelers who want to explore Tirol by car.
